name: Gigacatalyst
long_description:
Gigacatalyst allows your customers to build analytics, dashboards, reports, forms, from inside your product. We’ve helped our customers expand $1M in sales in 6 weeks.

We do this with an embedded AI customization layer that learns your APIs. Each customer can now build on top of your product to match their workflows perfectly, and share it across their team in one click.

The result is that customers use your SaaS more, retain for longer, and expand quicker, because they get bespoke dashboards for their exact usecase, without waiting.

We're live with the top Series B companies with 90% repeat usage rate.
one_liner: AI-first embedded analytics and reports for customer success
